# Emir Şahin - Portfolio

Emir Şahin is a professional content creator, videographer, and video editor based in Turkey. 
He specializes in producing high-quality commercials, social media content, and creative video projects for various brands.

## Main Services
- Video Production (Commercials, Social Media Reels, Promos)
- Video Editing & Post Production
- AI Visuals & Creative Direction
